from donations import load_donations, ROWS
from register import DonationBook


def test_total_after_add():
    rows = list(load_donations())
    book = DonationBook()
    book.add(rows[0])
    assert book.total() == ROWS[0][1]
    book.add(rows[1])
    assert book.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]


def test_total_after_every_add():
    book = DonationBook()
    running = 0
    for x in load_donations():
        book.add(x)
        running += x.pounds
        assert book.total() == running


def test_empty_book():
    assert DonationBook().total() == 0


def test_count():
    book = DonationBook()
    for x in load_donations():
        book.add(x)
    assert book.count() == len(ROWS)
